body:
## Destination

An evidence-backed, implementation-ready repair specification for the two original projected basins: reproducible residual failures, confirmed causal mechanisms, and a justified repair design under the existing public-API acceptance criteria.

## Notes

- Planning effort. Completion means the route to the repair is clear; implementation and landing follow this map.
- The governing requirements are [Implementation spec: finish the projected-basin fix](https://github.com/atsyplenkov/surfer2-rs/issues/1#issuecomment-6873800700), attached to [`interior_straight_skeleton` fails on large UTM basin polygons (overflow / incomplete DCEL)](https://github.com/atsyplenkov/surfer2-rs/issues/1). The regression guard is [`finite_segments()` returns disconnected linework for a valid UTM river polygon](https://github.com/atsyplenkov/surfer2-rs/issues/2).
- Confirmed with the maintainer: Arm A's velocity-selection policy and directed-halfedge deduplication both remain open to revision. Independent upstream research and independently computed small-case expectations are in scope.
- Working control: `d1a89fd66795f537b034f220ed4f838bd0fdea3b`. Committed comparison: `fix/issue-1-arm-a` at `1b6ed8ea9af51ed9f82f99d56306abc6f6359c7c`. These contain local, unpublished commits. The comparison is an experiment, not a prescribed foundation.
- Read Grok's handoff at `/tmp/handoff-surfer2-issue-1-projected-basins.md` and its linked reports in `/tmp/swarm-issue1/`. Main's untracked diagnostics and test file differ from Arm A's committed artifacts. Preserve existing work and distinguish exact commits from dirty experiments.
- The handoff supplies useful observations, not a demonstrated ancestry-based classifier. `SuccessorMotion::Degenerate` describes supporting-line conditioning; constraint-collapse children use a different construction path. Existing bounded-cycle validation does not establish connected finite output.
- Every working session consults `diagnosing-bugs`, `domain-modeling`, and `gh`; follow the ticket's type-specific skill as well. Treat reported, code-inspected, and freshly reproduced evidence distinctly. Record input hashes, source revisions and dirty-diff hashes, commands, profiles, and skipped checks.
- Research uses primary sources and throwaway `research/<name>` branches. Publish linked findings there; open no PR and never merge those branches. Research branches start from published `origin/master`, keeping unpublished engine experiments out of their ancestry.
- Children and native dependency edges are the live frontier. Claim a ticket by assigning it to the driving maintainer before work. Resolve at most one non-research ticket per session. Record answers in resolution comments and link their gists below.

- Keep replay evidence, raw logs, and diagnostic prototypes on retained non-main branches/tags, linked by commit from their tickets. Propose only the eventual repair and its necessary regression tests/fixtures for `master`.
- The [preserved ancestry-matched basin-2 evidence](https://github.com/atsyplenkov/surfer2-rs/blob/e3cfa2a65315f01e1f0082a36bd1f03adb858600/evidence/issue-5/ancestry-preserving.md) is an interim diagnostic asset, not a resolved decision. Bounded witness decisions may finish with supported requirements or a precise blocker; they need not prove every event in the full basin. The broader investigation retains responsibility for the other residuals and integration.

## Decisions so far

<!-- One named link and one-line gist per resolved decision ticket. -->

- [Establish upstream successor and collapse-event invariants](https://github.com/atsyplenkov/surfer2-rs/issues/4#issuecomment-6877043273): Established birth/support/co-arrival and same-time lifecycle contracts; source divergences remain hypotheses about basin causality.

- [Choose independent checks for event geometry and point-contact topology](https://github.com/atsyplenkov/surfer2-rs/issues/7#issuecomment-6877044243): Certified small-case calculations and exact contact arrangements supply independent checks; CGAL excludes the touching-hole basin.

- [Make the projected-basin experiments reproducible](https://github.com/atsyplenkov/surfer2-rs/issues/6#issuecomment-6879469382): Preserved and independently verified the control/experimental replay; evidence stays on a retained branch/tag outside master, enabling the first-invalid-event investigation.

## Not yet specified

- Additional failure mechanisms that may appear after the first invalid event in each residual basin is isolated; whether these require separate witnesses and decisions remains unknown.
- The concrete repair policy and module boundaries across the remaining residuals, including how bounded witness decisions combine with precision, event scheduling, ancestry, and trace identity. The 12-vertex basin-2 birth/collapse/shared-endpoint requirements are now a specified child decision, not fog; the eventual design must still explain both basin failures and the river counterexamples.
- Residual-event-specific regression and metamorphic cases, numerical error budgets beyond the bounded 12-vertex basin-2 decision, and the final mapping from confirmed mechanisms to the existing acceptance criteria.

## Out of scope

- Shipping, merging, or declaring the original basin bug fixed during this planning map.
- Changes to the R wrapper, GEOS, CRS gating, downstream centerlines, the public API, or new weighted/component features.
- Input simplification or snapping, mandatory coordinate translation, tolerance stitching, bypassing bounded-cycle validation, dropping real ridges, or weakening existing frozen oracles.
- A replacement skeleton engine or a general exact-arithmetic production backend. Higher-precision diagnostic/reference calculations remain in scope.
- Treating face numbers as acceptance criteria, assuming a tree or a cycle rank from the first basin's ring count, or adopting a basin-versus-river classifier before it is demonstrated.
